CREATE TABLE "public"."shopBusinessSettings" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'USD' NOT NULL,
  "deliveryBoundariesInclusive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "deliveryEndTime" text DEFAULT '17:00' NOT NULL,
  "deliveryStartTime" text DEFAULT '07:00' NOT NULL,
  "deliveryTimeZone" text DEFAULT 'America/Guayaquil' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "maxUnitsPerSkuPerOrder" int4 DEFAULT 10 NOT NULL,
  "shippingAmountCents" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "shippingIncludedInPrices" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "shippingStatus" text DEFAULT 'FREE_INCLUDED' NOT NULL,
  "singletonKey" text DEFAULT 'GLOBAL' NOT NULL,
  "taxEnabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "taxMode" text DEFAULT 'SIMULATED' NOT NULL,
  "taxRateBps" int4 DEFAULT 1500 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "updatedById" text,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "shop_settings_singleton_23de2fff" CHECK ("singletonKey" = 'GLOBAL'),
  CONSTRAINT "shop_settings_valid_abaee184" CHECK (version >= 1 AND currency = 'USD' AND "shippingStatus" = 'FREE_INCLUDED' AND "shippingAmountCents" = 0 AND "shippingIncludedInPrices" = true AND "taxMode" = 'SIMULATED' AND "taxRateBps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "maxUnitsPerSkuPerOrder" BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND "deliveryTimeZone" = 'America/Guayaquil' AND "deliveryBoundariesInclusive" = true AND "deliveryStartTime" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' AND "deliveryEndTime" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' AND "deliveryStartTime" < "deliveryEndTime")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."shopSettingsAudit" (
  "actorId" text NOT NULL,
  "changedFields" json NOT NULL,
  "expectedVersion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "newVersion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "recordedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "settingsId" text NOT NULL,
  "snapshot" json NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "shop_settings_audit_version_step_ba9c3ee0" CHECK ("expectedVersion" >= 1 AND "newVersion" = "expectedVersion" + 1)
)
